# gpupaas_bare_metal_instance (Resource)

A first-class bare-metal machine (`dev.envmgmt.io/v1` `BareMetal`), created from a bare-metal SKU (BmProfile). Creating the resource provisions a machine from the SKU's inventory and waits until it is running, which takes many minutes. Use the `gpupaas_bare_metal_sku` data source to see which images, datacenters and options a SKU allows; Terraform checks your values against it at plan time. Power actions (`start`, `stop`, `power_cycle`, `power_reset`) are driven by `desired_action`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# See what the bare-metal SKU allows first: images, datacenters, public IP policy, contract terms.
data "gpupaas_bare_metal_sku" "gpu" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "bmaas-l40s"
}

# The workspace (team-a) and the SSH key (admin-key) must exist: create them with the gpupaas_workspace and
# gpupaas_ssh_key resources, or in the console.

# One machine from the SKU. Creating it provisions real hardware and waits until it runs,
# which takes many minutes. Changing `type` or `image` replaces the machine.
resource "gpupaas_bare_metal_instance" "demo" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "demo-machine"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    type    = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.name
    image   = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.default_image
    ssh_key = "admin-key"

    # Day-2 (running machine, updated in place; the workflow re-runs for about a minute):
    # security_group  = "web-sg"   # attach, change or remove a security group of the workspace
    # assign_public_ip = true      # Public IP Assignment, when the SKU allows it
    datacenter = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.datacenters[0]
  }

  # Power actions: "start" and "stop" run when the machine is not already in that state,
  # "power_cycle" and "power_reset" run when the value changes. Leave unset or "none" to do nothing.
  # desired_action = "stop"

  timeouts = {
    create = "60m"
    delete = "30m"
  }
}

output "machine_address" {
  description = "Where to log in."
  value       = gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.public_ip != null ? gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.public_ip : gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.private_ip
}

output "login_user" {
  value = gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo.status.user_name
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Standard metadata block (name, project, workspace, display_name, description, labels, annotations, created_by, modified_by). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `desired_action` (String) A power action to run on the machine: `start`, `stop`, `power_cycle` (force power off and back on), `power_reset` (reset the hardware power state) or `reboot`. `start` and `stop` run only when the machine is not already in that power state; the other actions run when the value changes. An action runs during an apply that changes `desired_action`; Terraform does not undo a power change made outside Terraform. If an action fails, an error leaves the previous value in the state so the next apply retries it; on create it is only a warning, so the machine is not tainted. The platform decides which actions a machine accepts: its environment template lists them (the BCM node-provision template offers `start`, `stop`, `Power cycle`, `Power reset`, `Reinstall OS` and `Replace Instance`, and refuses `reboot`). When an action is refused the error lists what is accepted. Leave unset or `none` to do nothing.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Time limits as durations such as `45m`. Defaults: create 60m, update 30m, delete 30m, action 20m. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<workspace>/<name>`, or `<project>/<name>` for a project-scoped instance.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `image` (String) Operating system image, one of the SKU's images. Changing it replaces the machine (the platform reinstalls an OS only through its `Reinstall OS` action).
- `type` (String) The bare-metal SKU (BmProfile) to create the machine from. Changing it replaces the machine.

Optional:

- `assign_public_ip` (Boolean) Assign a public IP. Allowed only when the SKU's public IP policy is `Enabled` or `CustomerSelectable`. Day-2: switch it on or off on a running machine (the console's Public IP Assignment edit); the machine is updated in place, not replaced, and the platform re-runs its workflow for about a minute.
- `contract_term` (Number) Contract term in months, one the SKU offers.
- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter the machine is placed in, one of the SKU's datacenters. Defaults to the SKU's only datacenter.
- `hss_storage` (String) Name of a high-speed shared filesystem storage to mount.
- `object_storage` (String) Name of an object storage to attach.
- `security_group` (String) Name of an existing security group of the workspace. Day-2: change it, or remove the attribute to detach the group, on a running machine (the console's Security Group edit); the machine is updated in place, not replaced. The platform re-runs the machine's workflow for about a minute.
- `sharing` (Attributes) Resource sharing across workspaces or projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing))
- `ssh_key` (String) Name of an existing SSH key in the instance's workspace to install. Set this, `user_password`, or both.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet of the VPC. Defaults to the SKU's subnet.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init script as plain text; the platform encodes it. Kept as configured: the API's stored form is not compared. Marked sensitive because scripts often carry secrets (the platform's own cloud-init for cluster nodes embeds credentials), so it is hidden in plans and CLI output; it is still stored in the Terraform state, so protect the state.
- `user_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the machine's user. Write-only: the API never returns it, so Terraform cannot detect a change made elsewhere. It is sent on create and again only when you change it here. It is stored in the Terraform state, so protect the state.
- `vpc` (String) VPC to attach the machine to. Defaults to the SKU's VPC.

Read-Only:

- `compute_instance_id` (String) Identifier of the hidden compute instance behind the machine, which holds its workflow log.
- `gpu_name` (String) GPU model, inherited from the SKU.
- `provisioner_type` (String) How the platform provisions the machine: `bcm` or `non_bcm`.

- `workspaces` (List of String) Workspaces shared with when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <project>/<workspace>/<name>, or <project>/<name> for a project-scoped machine
terraform import gpupaas_bare_metal_instance.demo system-catalog/team-a/demo-machine
```
